case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We ordered from you at EUR 339.37 per unit in 2024-09 and at EUR 348.32 per unit in 2026-09 (po:4500011414-10, po:4500014474-10). With the index clause the price follows copper beyond the deadband, so the copper risk no longer has to be priced in up front. On that basis we propose EUR 343.47 per unit, payment 90 days net, an index clause on CU-NOTATION (20 % material share, deadband 5 %, base month 2026-08).

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We agree to implement the CU-NOTATION index clause, which effectively addresses the copper risk as you suggested. We are also willing to accommodate your request for a 90-day payment term. Based on these terms, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 351.45. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

Our current Angebot entails a price of €351.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

thank you for your reply and for moving towards us. We do not want a price that leaves you below a sustainable margin: a healthy supplier matters more to us than the last euro. We can improve our proposal to EUR 361.35 per unit, payment 90 days net, an index clause on CU-NOTATION (20 % material share, deadband 5 %, base month 2026-08). Could you meet us there?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Please be assured that our previous offer of EUR 351.45 per unit is economically viable for us. We are therefore pleased to hold our offer at EUR 351.45 per unit with the agreed 90-day payment term and CU-NOTATION index clause.

Accordingly, our Angebot comprises a price of €351.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
